definitions.full: H2936. tanaph [ טָנַף ] verb soil, defile (Late Hebrew Pi`el id. ; Aramaic Pa`el טַנֵּף , ; Assyrian ‰anâpu II, I, Dl Pr 33 ; HWB 302; Arabic is be suspicious, be intrinsically corrupt ) — Pi`el Imperfect אֲטַנְּפֵם Song 5:3 how should I soil them , i.e. my feet (poetic Aramaism).
